# Meridian Marine Co. — Vendor Coordination & Approval Standard v1

## Purpose

Define how MMC moves an owner request or operational finding into authorized third-party work.

## Coordination flow

**IDENTIFY → SCOPE → QUOTE → APPROVE → SCHEDULE → EXECUTE → VERIFY → CLOSE**

### Identify
Determine the vessel issue, requested service, or operational need.

### Scope
Clarify what the vendor is being asked to do and what remains outside the assignment.

### Quote
Obtain a quote or reasonable estimate when appropriate.

### Approve
Obtain owner approval when required by the client agreement or expense-control standard. Emergency authority may apply only where previously defined.

### Schedule
Confirm vendor, timing, vessel access, and relevant instructions.

### Execute
Vendor performs the authorized service.

### Verify
MMC confirms completion to the extent appropriate to its scope, documenting visible outcomes or unresolved issues without pretending to provide specialist certification.

### Close
Update the vessel/action/vendor records and reconcile invoices or outstanding follow-up.

## Authorization boundary

MMC coordinates and documents. MMC does not authorize unlimited third-party spending on behalf of an owner unless the client agreement expressly provides that authority.

## Communication standard

Vendor instructions should be clear, written where practical, and tied to the specific vessel/job. Material changes in scope or cost should be surfaced before additional work proceeds where practical.
